acceptance.inference_scope: conditional on the fixed synthetic channel, declared waveform noise, NR configuration, and sampled payloads; not a field BLER claim
acceptance.protocol: same seeded payloads and sample-domain proper-complex AWGN; fixed two-path integer-delay channel; CPU PUSCH transmit, OFDM, and DMRS-estimating receiver

configuration.awgn_model: independent proper-complex Gaussian sample noise; same realization reused across all paired channel conditions
configuration.symbol_static_control: echo phase evaluated at OFDM-symbol start and held through symbol; inter-symbol aging retained

intra_symbol_acceptance.inference_scope: conditional on this fixed synthetic channel and sampled payloads; the symbol-static model is a diagnostic control, not a deployment channel
intra_symbol_acceptance.interpretation: continuous sample-time Doppler versus equal Doppler frozen at each OFDM-symbol start; both include inter-symbol aging and identical waveform AWGN
